openings.claim: The weakly magnetic spare could hold position and support gloved swaps through a mechanically indexed pocket. Strips bolted through existing slots supply side capture and end stops behind the marked edge; a movable fourth-strip gate supplies edge-free handling. Optional wire retains gate hardware; plate pickup uses an accessible unmarked surface, without assuming gate lift.
openings.discriminator: Against a cork-lined friction clamp, contact capture predicts <=1 mm displacement with light seating pressure while reduced clamp pressure may permit drift. Equal success leaves the mechanism unresolved. Pocket drift, trapped extraction, or slow gloved service defeats the capability.
openings.probe: Map slots, clearance, exposed edge and pickup access; verify bolt fit, strip bendability and sub-millimetre pocket play before fabrication. Abandon infeasible geometry. Drill strips only; do not drill, cut, heat or glue plate/carriage; expose the marked 30 mm edge, avoid stroke clearance and keep carriage on rails. Within 80 fabrication/20 observation minutes, build at most pocket and clamp; perform up to three twenty-stroke runs and three gloved removal/return checks each. Record displacement and qualitative seating pressure; use spare for final run. Require <=60 seconds and no marked-edge contact. Stop on intrusion or necessary edge contact.
openings.uncertainty: Slot geometry, strip stiffness, supplied hardware and unmarked pickup access remain unverified. Stroke duration may force fewer runs, reducing confidence. Pull-scale escape comparisons up to 10 N cannot establish resistance to unknown stroke forces. The 3 N versus 7 N magnetic anomaly motivates reduced magnetic dependence; it proves neither retention nor serviceability.

lineage.reason: Preserves the causal change, rival, defeat conditions and feasibility dependencies.

decision: Retain one bounded enabling experiment. Check geometry first; proceed only if all hard constraints fit. Success requires <=1 mm displacement across twenty strokes and compliant timed return.
